settings.title: OniMcp Settings
settings.language.help: Applies to MCP-owned text. Game object names follow the game's language. Reconnect your MCP client after changing this setting to refresh its tool descriptions.
settings.host.help: Use localhost for local access, or an IP address for network access. Non-loopback hosts require authentication.
settings.port.help: Default: 8788. Saving settings restarts the server.
settings.auth.help: Disabled by default for loopback access. Non-loopback hosts require authentication.
settings.token.help: The current token is never displayed. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a new token to rotate it.
settings.disinfect.help: Keeps global auto disinfect disabled to prioritize duplicants.
settings.saved: Settings saved. The MCP listener is restarting now. Reconnect your MCP client to refresh tool descriptions.
settings.savedPort: Settings saved. The server is restarting on port {0}. Reopen this page at http://localhost:{0}/settings/ and reconnect your MCP client.
settings.error.title: Forbidden
settings.error.localOnly: The settings page is available only from the local machine.
settings.error.host: Host must be localhost or an IP address.
settings.error.language: Choose auto, en, ja, or zh-Hans for the MCP language.
settings.printingPod: Require acceptance or rejection of Printing Pod offers
settings.printingPod.help: ON: the agent must accept one care package or reject all offers. OFF: this feature gives no guidance, decision requests, or reminders; everything is left to agent context. Does not pause the game or automatically select rewards.
policy.printingPod.required: Before routine work, inspect Printing Pod offers and accept one care package or reject all offers. Deferring or ignoring does not resolve the offer. To reject all, use building_control domain=side_surface surface=facility kind=printing_pod action=reject_all confirm=true. Open unmaterialized choices with action=open_immigrants confirm=true. Do not automatically select duplicants. If an operation is unavailable, report why without claiming resolution.
